# AI Cricket Coach

> AI Cricket Coach is an AI-powered cricket video analysis and training platform for cricket players. Players upload or record a batting or bowling video and receive structured technique observations, drills and a training plan.

Current status: player profiles, video recording/upload and video validation are live. The AI video-analysis engine (pose-estimation based feedback) is under active development; until it is connected the app states that analysis is unavailable rather than showing invented results.

## Core features
- Player profiles (role, level, goal)
- Video recording or gallery upload with checks for length (3-90 s), size (under 200 MB), resolution and lighting
- Private per-account video storage
- General training-drill library: batting, fast bowling, spin bowling, wicketkeeping, fielding, fitness
- Planned/in development: AI technique observations with High/Medium/Low confidence, 7-day training plans, progress comparison

## Supported analysis types
Batting, Fast Bowling, Spin Bowling, Wicketkeeping, Fielding

- [Bowling analysis](https://aicricketcoach.app/bowling-analysis.html): run-up, delivery stride, arm action, release

## Important limitations
- Analysis is based on a single 2D video; it cannot measure ball speed, spin revolutions or internal joint loading.
- Observations are labelled with confidence levels; unclear movements are reported as "unable to assess reliably".
- It does not diagnose injuries or give medical advice, does not guarantee performance improvement, and does not replace a qualified cricket coach.
- Signed-in areas (dashboard, profile, analysis history, uploaded videos) are private and are not public content.
